result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.gwas_pipeline()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Run a GWAS-style network analysis pipeline. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L16424-L16557){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.gwas_pipeline( scores, smooth_alpha=0.5, smooth_max_iter=100, community_method="louvain", community_resolution=1.0, enrichment_attr=None, enrichment_labels=None, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![GWAS network pipeline](/assets/graphs/gwas-pipeline.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="The eight-gene network after the pipeline: raw scores of 4.0 on G1, G2, G3 and 0.5 elsewhere are smoothed over the network, so every gene is shaded by its smoothed score and the signal leaks onto G4. Louvain then splits the network into module 1, G1 to G4, and module 0, G5 to G8, drawn as gray regions. The table ranks the modules by mean smoothed score, 3.05 for module 1 and 0.57 for module 0." width="100%"} Chains three steps: 1. network smoothing: propagates raw scores (e.g., -log10 p-values) over the graph to denoise using neighborhood context. 2. community detection: partitions the smoothed graph into modules. 3. module scoring: computes mean smoothed score per module and ranks modules by aggregate signal. Optionally, if `enrichment_attr=` and `enrichment_labels=` are provided, runs subgraph enrichment on each community to test for over-representation of labeled nodes. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [scores]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [dict[int, float]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Dictionary mapping node IDs to raw scores (e.g., GWAS -log10(p-value) or differential expression fold change). [smooth_alpha]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[0.5]{.fl}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Smoothing strength (0–1). Higher values give more weight to network neighbors. [smooth_max_iter]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[100]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Maximum smoothing iterations. [community_method]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["louvain"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Community detection method: `"louvain"` or `"walktrap"`. [community_resolution]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[1.0]{.fl}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Resolution parameter for community detection (Louvain only). [enrichment_attr]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional node attribute name for enrichment testing. [enrichment_labels]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[int] | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional list of node IDs considered as the "positive" set for enrichment testing. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [dict]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A dictionary with: - `smoothed_scores`: dict mapping node IDs to smoothed values. - `communities`: dict mapping community ID to list of node IDs. - `module_scores`: dict mapping community ID to mean smoothed score, sorted descending. - `enrichment` (if requested): dict mapping community ID to enrichment p-value. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#c5a08d31 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec g = ec.Graph() for i in range(12): g.add_node(label=str(i)) for i in range(4): for j in range(i + 1, 4): g.add_edge(source=str(i), target=str(j)) for i in range(4, 8): for j in range(i + 1, 8): g.add_edge(source=str(i), target=str(j)) for i in range(8, 12): for j in range(i + 1, 12): g.add_edge(source=str(i), target=str(j)) g.add_edge(source="3", target="4") g.add_edge(source="7", target="8") scores = {} for i in range(4): scores[g.get_id_from_label(str(i))] = 5.0 for i in range(4, 12): scores[g.get_id_from_label(str(i))] = 0.5 result = g.gwas_pipeline(scores) result["module_scores"] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` {2: 4.759969689412005, 1: 0.734925871664258, 0: 0.5051044389237371} ``` ::: :::
